name: pstack
description: Lauren Tan's pstack agent workflows for Farero: poteto-mode and its playbooks, skills to design, review, verify and explain code, 24 engineering principles, and roles for its helpers.

lead.title: pstack lead
lead.description: Runs a pstack skill such as poteto-mode as the chat that owns the playbook, briefs the helpers, reviews their work and writes the report.

poteto-agent.title: Poteto subagent
poteto-agent.description: Does one code-writing or helper task from a poteto-mode playbook step after it reads poteto-mode in full.

second-opinion.title: Second model family
second-opinion.description: Runs the same brief as a poteto subagent on another model family, for adversaries, cross-judges, arena candidates and independent reviews.

comment-sicko.title: Comment Sicko
comment-sicko.description: Deletes narration and workaround comments in the scoped files or diff and reports the symbols to reshape. It never writes application code.

poteto-mode.title: Poteto mode
poteto-mode.description: The lead runs the matching poteto-mode playbook. Poteto subagents do the code-writing steps, a second model family checks the work, and Comment Sicko cleans the comments before review.
poteto-mode.objective: Run /poteto-mode on this task: <describe the task>. Match it to a playbook, follow the playbook's steps, and verify the result against the real artifact before you report.

interrogate.title: Interrogate a change
interrogate.description: Adversaries on two model families try to break the change, and the lead keeps only the findings that a rerun proves.
interrogate.objective: Run /interrogate on the current branch against its base. Keep only the findings that a rerun proves, ranked by severity, each with the input that breaks the change and the line that causes it.
